text:
Nina: Tiny schedule change: we’re going to bring Q&A forward to 13:50 so execs can finish early. Also flag: the stream recorder lost a segment during rehearsal. Can AV Team confirm we have a splice/merge plan?

Theo: moving Q&A earlier works. recommend keeping 5 mins buffer before demos for slide swap.

Ravi: saw recorder gap too. possible disk spin-up delay on NAS. tail from room box:
```
[recorder] write error: No space left on device
[kernel] sdg: device write cache enabled
```

AV Team: we're checking NAS quotas. immediate mitigation: toggle local rolling record in OBS (5GB files) and rsync slices to /mnt/nas/ah-recordings as they close. Also we have an inline splice script if upload completes. Need permission to start rolling.

Nina: go ahead with rolling files. also mark event for post-upload QA.

Jordan: @all-hands-bot can you nudge folks to stash any slide updates in the #all-hands-deck channel by 13:40?

all-hands-bot: Reminder posted to #all-hands: please upload final slides to #all-hands-deck by 13:40 UTC.

Sophie: question about live captions: will the fallback OBS path preserve captions? Accessibility asked.

AV Team: yes, we're running the caption overlay inside OBS; it's recorded into frames and burned into the fallback MP4. We'll also capture raw SRT feed and upload alongside.

OpsBot: Network alert: intermittent latency spike on conference subnet at 13:43 UTC. Avg latency 85ms for 30s then recovered. No dropped packets reported.

Ravi: started the rolling-record change. OBS profile 'all-hands-rolling' active. current file: ah-1787833333-part-1.mkv

Theo: also FYI for leadership segment, the roadmap slide on Dedicated capacity contains a pricing bullet that changed this morning. Flagged for Q&A.

Nina: noted. Jordan will do the short pricing bit during Q&A and Priya will take deep dives after.

AV Team: splicer script ready. once uploads finish we can stitch parts and upload final master to the public bucket. ETA for stitch after upload: ~3-5m.

Jordan: thanks. @AV Team when everything's uploaded, post the final path in #all-hands and then close.

AV Team: upload job started for ah-1787833333-part-1.mkv; progress 12%.

Sophie: adding reminder to moderators to surface top-voted remote questions first.

Theo: routing change works for me. I'll be moderating live votes.

AV Team: upload complete for part-1. starting part-2. splicer will run after last part completes.

OpsBot: Conference subnet latency normalized at 13:47 UTC.

Nina: great. Q&A in 5. thanks team for quick fixes.

Jordan: closing thread; will reopen if we need follow-up actions. thanks :raised_hands:
